metadata.source: City of Fremont GIS Division — Police_Zones public feature service; historical official-source geometry used as approximate study areas
metadata.verificationStatus: City GIS source and geographic coordinates verified; current legal adoption unverified
metadata.screenshotReference: User-supplied 905×617 Fremont Police patrol-zone map screenshot received 2026-10-18 in this conversation; used for visual comparison, not coordinate digitization. No local image file or original image publication date was exposed.

calibration.method: Direct import of georeferenced City GIS polygon coordinates, exported by the service into WGS84 EPSG:4326. No manual coordinate invention or screenshot digitization. Independent manual comparison with the supplied screenshot matches the city silhouette, north Zone 1 apex, Zone 2 western corner, Newark recess, Zone 2/3 southwest junction and Zone 3 southeast edge.
calibration.uncertaintyInterpretation: 75 m is a conservative application boundary-review band for ambiguous street assignments. It is not a measured GIS positional accuracy, image-registration residual, or guarantee of current patrol adoption.

metadata.notice: Patrol-zone boundaries are approximate study areas based on the Fremont Police Department's published map. They are not verified official GIS boundaries.
metadata.adoptionStatus: The current official status of the proposed October 6, 2026 changes has not been confirmed. A historical GIS publication and visual screenshot match do not establish legal adoption.
metadata.sourceAccessNote: The public ArcGIS City GIS feature service was retrieved successfully on 2026-10-18. The police webpage and municipal website returned upstream Akamai HTTP 403, preventing an independent check of the latest adoption record.
metadata.geometryValidation: All three source polygons valid under GEOS/Shapely; pairwise interior overlap area is zero. All original source rings, including tiny holes, are retained without simplification.
metadata.license: The City ArcGIS item and XML metadata state City of Fremont - GIS Division credit but provide no explicit reuse license. Preserve source credit and review City data terms before public redistribution.
limitations: Historical official-source GIS geometry is used as approximate learning areas; current 2026 patrol adoption and exact match to current legal boundaries are unverified.
The screenshot has no exposed source image file or publication date, so comparison is qualitative rather than a measured image registration.
The 75 m ambiguity band is application policy, not a source accuracy claim; historical version uncertainty may exceed that band.
Road coverage is limited to bounded central Fremont and northern Irvington source extracts. None of these polygons implies complete zone street coverage.
Street segments near a boundary or crossing more than one zone need ambiguous classification rather than a forced unique assignment.
Original GIS rings and holes are preserved. The developer editor changes only local study polygons and never changes the road graph.
